info.name: MyAdvisor API Tests
info.description:
API tests for MyAdvisor (COMP 3613 A2).

Before each run: `python manage.py init` then `python manage.py run`. Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner (or `newman run postman/myadvisor.postman_collection.json`). The run approves the demo student's plan, so re-run `python manage.py init` before running again.

item.name: 0. Authentication & Authorization
item.description: Login for each role, token checks, admin-only user list.

exec: pm.test("Error message is correct", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Incorrect username or password"));
pm.test("Response is JSON, not the HTML page", () => pm.response.to.be.json);

item.name: Get current user with invalid token

exec: pm.test("Lists the seeded users", () => pm.expect(users.map(u => u.username)).to.include.members(["bob", "admin", "advisor"]));
pm.test("Error message is correct", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("You do not have permission to access this resource."));

item.name: 1. Track Degree Audit & Plan Semester Courses (Student)
item.description: Workflow 1 — catalog, audit, add/remove courses, planning rules.

exec: pm.test("Only MATH1001 is in Mathematics", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(c => c.code)).to.eql(["MATH1001"]));
pm.test("Error message is correct", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("You do not have permission to access this resource."));
pm.test("Plan is an empty Draft", () => { pm.expect(plan.status).to.eql("Draft"); pm.expect(plan.courses).to.be.empty; pm.expect(plan.total_credits).to.eql(0); });
pm.test("COMP1002 placed in Year 1 - Semester 1", () => { pm.expect(item.course.code).to.eql("COMP1002"); pm.expect(item.placement).to.eql("Year 1 - Semester 1"); });
pm.test("Error message is correct", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("That course is already in this plan."));
pm.test("Error message is correct", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("The selected course does not exist."));
pm.test("Error message is correct", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Choose a valid year and term destination."));

item.name: (Student) Remove course that is not in plan

exec: pm.test("Error message is correct", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("That course is not in this plan."));
pm.test("Error message is correct", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("A semester cannot exceed 16 credits."));
pm.test("Plan has 6 courses and 18 credits", () => { pm.expect(plan.courses).to.have.lengthOf(6); pm.expect(plan.total_credits).to.eql(18); });

item.name: 2. Submit Course Selection Plan for Approval (Student)

exec: pm.test("Notes are stored", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().notes).to.eql("Please check my electives."));
pm.test("Plan is Pending Review", () => pm.expect(body.status).to.eql("Pending Review"));
pm.test("Error message is correct", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Only draft or revision-requested plans can be changed."));
pm.test("Error message is correct", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Only draft or revision-requested plans can be submitted."));
pm.test("Error message is correct", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("You do not have permission to access this resource."));

item.name: 3. Review and Approve Course Selection Plan (Advisor)

exec: pm.test("Submitted plan is in the queue", () => pm.expect(entry).to.not.be.undefined);
pm.test("Shows student John Doe, Pending Review", () => { pm.expect(entry.student_name).to.eql("John Doe"); pm.expect(entry.status).to.eql("Pending Review"); });
pm.test("Proposed courses are included", () => pm.expect(body.plan.courses.map(c => c.course.code)).to.include("COMP1002"));
pm.test("Error message is correct", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("That plan is not assigned to this advisor."));
pm.test("Error message is correct", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Advising notes are required when requesting revisions."));
pm.test("Error message is correct", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Choose Approve Plan or Request Revisions."));
pm.test("Status and advisor notes are shown", () => { pm.expect(plan.status).to.eql("Revision Requested"); pm.expect(plan.advisor_notes).to.eql("Please add WRIT1001 to Year 1 - Semester 2."); });
pm.test("Plan is Pending Review again", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql("Pending Review"));
pm.test("Error message is correct", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Only plans pending review can receive an advisor decision."));
pm.test("Plan is Approved with an approval time", () => { pm.expect(plan.status).to.eql("Approved"); pm.expect(plan.approved_at).to.not.be.null; });
pm.test("WRIT1001 is in the approved plan", () => pm.expect(plan.courses.map(c => c.course.code)).to.include("WRIT1001"));
pm.test("Approved plan left the queue", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(p => p.plan_id)).to.not.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("planId")));
